annotation.title_clean: Adenda. Segunda Fase del Plan de Recuperación, Transformación y Resiliencia del Reino de España. Impulso a la Industrialización Estratégica
annotation.title_en: Addendum. Second Phase of the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan of the Kingdom of Spain. Boost to Strategic Industrialisation
annotation.venue: Gobierno de España – Plan de Recuperación, Transformación y Resiliencia
annotation.summary_en: Spain's September 2023 addendum to its Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan, mobilising about €10bn in extra grants and up to €84bn in loans for strategic autonomy in energy, food, industry, technology and digital. It mentions an AI Supervisory Agency only in passing and has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mobilises €7.7bn additional MRR transfers, €2.6bn REPowerEU and up to €84bn loans
Reinforces PERTE strategic projects including PERTE CHIP, ERHA and VEC
Creates twelve loan-financed funds including a cyber-resilience and security instrument
Includes 17 reforms, among them launching the AI Supervision Agency and updating the National Security Scheme
Modifies milestones under Article 21 of Regulation (EU) 2021/241
